scope: Required V2 N-panel runtime and automatic invalidation; no GUI operation was performed.

findings.requirement: The N-panel must remain operable while editing and after external input changes.
findings.finding: Panel.draw invokes stale setters that mutate Scene ID properties; move mutation to a safe handler/timer and keep draw read-only.
findings.acceptance: Read-only draw path plus explicit safe polling/handler tests for Edit Mode and source/contact changes.

findings.requirement: An Author edit automatically invalidates old results and hides their overlay.
findings.finding: Initial test manually called the stale setter after an edge addition and therefore did not verify automatic invalidation.
findings.acceptance: Live mesh/BMesh mutation triggers the production poll/handler; assert stale state, cleared results and hidden overlay without calling the stale setter in the test.

findings.requirement: Virtual failure applies to the selected physical branch or joint ID.
findings.finding: Failure enum item order depends on the graph available at the current height; implicit numeric indices can change the selected identity after reevaluation.
findings.acceptance: Stable item numbers and retained enum strings; selection remains the same identity across height/mode changes, or explicitly resets and becomes stale.
